title: Mock exam in the style of Cambridge IGCSE Economics Paper 1
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on Cambridge IGCSE Economics 0455 Paper 1 (multiple choice): 40 questions, 40 marks, 1 hour, on all the subject content. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **all** 40 questions. You have 1 hour.

- Each question is worth 1 mark. Choose the one best answer.
- Diagrams are described in words and tables. You may use a calculator.
- The paper is marked when you submit or when the time runs out.

The format follows Paper 1 of the 2027-2029 syllabus. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.

title: Mock exam in the style of Cambridge IGCSE Economics Paper 2
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on Cambridge IGCSE Economics 0455 Paper 2 (structured questions): one compulsory 20-mark question on unseen information in Section A and a choice of 20-mark questions in Section B, answer three, 2 hours, 80 marks. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer the question in Section A and **three** questions from Section B. You have 2 hours.

- Each question is worth 20 marks. In Section B, part (d) asks you to discuss: consider both sides and reach a conclusion.
- If you answer more than three questions in Section B, your best three count.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows Paper 2 of the 2027-2029 syllabus; the part marks in Section B are our own convention. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.
